description: Erection of replacement two storey rear extension and associated external alterations including replacement windows to main house, infill of lower ground floor terrace to annex building and installation of rooflights, installation of external shading devices to the front and rear elevations of the main house; installation of replacement single gate and infill of existing double gate on Woronzow Road frontage with brick; installation of new condensers and associated enclosure.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans

A_PL_001; A_PL_009; A_PL_010; A_PL_011; A_PL_012; A_PL_013; A_PL_014; A_PL_020; A_PL_021; A_PL_022; A_PL_023; A_PL_024; A_PL_030, rev A; A_PL_031; A_PL_032; A_PL_033; A_PL_035; A_PL_036; A_DM_049, rev B; A_DM_050, rev C; A_DM_051, rev C; A_DM_052, rev B; A_DM_060, rev A; A_DM_061, rev A; A_DM_065; A_DM_066; A_DM_067; A_DM_068, rev A; A_PL_002; A_PL_099, rev F; A_PL_100, rev C; A_PL_101, rev E; A_PL_102, rev D; A_PL_103, rev C; A_PL_104, rev A; A_PL_200, rev B; A_PL_201, rev B; A_PL_202, rev B; A_PL_203, rev B; A_PL_204, rev A; A_PL_300, rev A; A_PL_301, rev A; A_PL_302, rev A; A_PL_303; A_PL_310; A_PL_311; A_33_001

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2  of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the work is begun, detailed drawings, or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority: 

a) Details including sections at 1:10 of all new and replacement windows (including jambs, head and cill), ventilation grills, external doors, gates and railings; 

b) External shading devices; 

c) Manufacturer's specification details of all facing materials (to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority) and samples of those materials (to be provided on site).    

The relevant part of the works shall be carried out in accordance with the details thus approved and all approved samples shall be retained on site during the course of the works. 

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Before the brickwork is commenced, a sample panel of the facing brickwork, in relation to the infilled gate to Woronzow Road, demonstrating the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approval given. The approved panel shall be retained on site until the work has been completed. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 6 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 7 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration-isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 8 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled "Report regarding the impact on trees of proposals for development at 34 Queens Grove, London, NW8 6HN " by John Cromar's Arboricultural Company Ltd. ref. S1267-J3-R1.  All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.

Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan.
Condition : 9 - External Shading Details

(a) Prior to commencement of development other than site clearance and preparation works, detailed drawings and specifications of the external shading measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The details shall include the design, dimensions, materials, colour/finish, fixing and installation method, and their relationship with the host building and surrounding context. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

(b) Prior to completion of the works, evidence shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority demonstrating that the approved external shading measures have been installed in accordance with the approved details and are fully operational. The external shading measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development

Reason: To ensure the delivery and retention of passive cooling measures that minimise overheating risk and support climate change adaptation, in accordance with Policy CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan.
Condition : 10 - Prior to completion of the works, evidence shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority demonstrating that the approved external shading measures have been installed in accordance with the approved details and are fully operational. The external shading measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.

Reason: To ensure the delivery and retention of passive cooling measures that minimise overheating risk and support climate change adaptation, in accordance with Policy CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan.
